name: Kaggle kernel watch
command:
while true; do
  s=$(kaggle kernels status saltbo/lev-encoder-modernbert-train 2>&1 | tail -1)
  echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) $s"
  case "$s" in
    *COMPLETE*|*ERROR*|*CANCEL*) break;;
  esac
  sleep 60
done
description: Poll Kaggle kernel status until it reaches a terminal state
